00503             }
00504             else {
00505                 m_pshifts[0]->ratio (1 * m_fundamental);
00506                 m_pshifts[1]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::PERFECT_FOURTH_INTERVAL)
00507                      * m_fundamental);
00508                 m_pshifts[2]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MINOR_SEVENTH_INTERVAL) / 2
00509                     * m_fundamental);
00510                 m_pshifts[3]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MINOR_THIRD_INTERVAL)
00511                      * m_fundamental);
00512             }     
00513         break;
00514         // ... //
00515         case Pandora::INTELLICHORD:
00516         break;
00517         case Pandora::SCALIC:
00518         break;
00519         // ... //
00520         case Pandora::MINOR_WITH_SIXTH:
00521             if (m_realFreq == true) {
00522                 m_pshifts[0]->frequency (1 * m_fundamental);
00523                 m_pshifts[1]->frequency (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MINOR_THIRD_INTERVAL) 
00524                      * m_fundamental);
00525                 m_pshifts[2]->frequency (m_tempered.get (Pandora::PERFECT_FIFTH_INTERVAL) / 2
00526                      * m_fundamental);
00527                 m_pshifts[3]->frequency (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MAJOR_SIXTH_INTERVAL) / 2
00528                      * m_fundamental);
00529             }
00530             else {
00531                 m_pshifts[0]->ratio (1 * m_fundamental);
00532                 m_pshifts[1]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MINOR_THIRD_INTERVAL)
00533                      * m_fundamental);
00534                 m_pshifts[2]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::PERFECT_FIFTH_INTERVAL) / 2 
00535                     * m_fundamental);
00536                 m_pshifts[3]->ratio (m_tempered.get (Pandora::MAJOR_SIXTH_INTERVAL) / 2
00537                      * m_fundamental);
00538             }     
00539         break;
00540         case Pandora::SINGLECHORD:
00541         break;      
00542     } 
00543   
00544     m_pshifts[0]->amplitude (.25);    
00545     m_pshifts[1]->amplitude (.35);    
00546     m_pshifts[2]->amplitude (.45);    
00547     m_pshifts[3]->amplitude (.50);    
00548 }
